next.reason: 1985: "WRITE record-name-1 [FROM identifier-1] [INVALID KEY imperative-statement-1] [NOT INVALID KEY ...]"; 2023: "WRITE {record-name-1|FILE file-name-1} [FROM {identifier-1|literal-1}] [retry-phrase] [WITH LOCK|WITH NO LOCK]". 2023 Format 2 (indexed/relative) adds the FILE phrase, a FROM literal, RETRY and LOCK phrases. Choice indicators let INVALID KEY and NOT INVALID KEY appear in either order.
